scope: Independent installed/native C03 records QA; bounded scratch-only corrections and two fresh diagnostic attempts. No product/repository/build/install/profile changes or commits.

findings.classification: Reproduced installed stage failure; source-supported harness topology conflict, not confirmed new records product defect
findings.reproduction: Qualify/publish final records once; start one native host/supervisor; prepare ORDERED new RUN, stage/bind/release/reconcile; then prepare EMPTY different RUN and stage on the same still-live host/root. Repeat on separate fresh DB reproduces.
findings.source_analysis: Managed RPC keeps one _ROOT/_SERVICE per process; stage returns that native root for each batch. managed_run enforces UNIQUE(runtime_boot,native_root_id), and commit_binding updates those columns for each RUN. The prepared driver attempted two RUNs on one root, unlike per-RUN native isolation. This explains a second binding SQL refusal but the exact DB constraint error was sanitized and not independently retained.
findings.disposition: STOP. Do not remove uniqueness, change product guards, reuse failed stage, or promote empty native admission. Parent should adjudicate per-RUN fresh native ownership and separately authorize another bounded fixture.

findings.observed: Original cli asserted expected exit before decoding structured reason. Attempt2 fixed capture and obtained CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE plus durable stage_started=true without binding. Both intermediate journey reports still say uncertain=false because only timeout/unknown exit/TASK_INDETERMINATE/CONTROL_TIMEOUT set the flag.
findings.disposition: Final report overrides any interpretation of uncertain=false as resolved stage authority. Native-stage outcome is unreconciled; normal supervisor/family drain and exact retirement prove cleanup only. Existing per-test finalizer dropped each disposable DB; public failure readback and retained PGDATA/logs remain, but no DB can be reused for historical reconciliation. No further attempt performed.
